conflict_resolution_defaults.interpretation: Claude defaults to Western liberal framing in the vast majority of value conflict scenarios. The RLHF pull toward individual autonomy, secular epistemology, and gender equality operates as an implicit tiebreaker that consistently favors one cultural perspective over all others.

cross_trial_mega_findings.finding: Claude clusters with less than 15% of global population. On the Inglehart-Welzel cultural map, its responses fall in the secular-rational / self-expression quadrant shared only by Northwestern European populations.
